'''Vincent Lee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2001 Vancouver tournament]] on 20 May 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down Dueling 7's]], according to Cole Roche's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2355">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-vancouver-british-columbia-20-5-01d2355/ vancouver-british-columbia-20-5-01], DeckTech (Cole "Rabid Wookie" Roche, 22 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-22-vancouver-british-columbia-20-5-01d2355/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
